collision_check: Names checked against the live OpenKit3D pack-folder list (218 folders), the live OpenKit 2D pack list, and the stems of earlier Open Kit packs. No live pack is named for cloister-walk, cloister-arcade, cloister-floor, cloister-bench, cloister-hopper, alms-box or cloister-trough. Nearby live packs (bathhouse, well-water, outdoor-props) and earlier Open Kit families (garden court, cistern, wayside shrine) are different families. No family was swapped.
judgment_calls: The arcade is a kit wall module (1.5 × 3.0 × 0.34 m, bottom-centre) with slim piers, imposts at about 2.05 m, and a pointed two-centred arch down to the floor. The floor tile is a kit floor module (1.5 × 1.5 × 0.12 m, floor_top) with a solid collider over the whole cell.

The arcade was snap-tested between two kit stone walls, and the floor tile was snap-tested in a ring of kit stone floor tiles: 0 intersections, with height, thickness, top and bottom matching the kit modules.
This is deliberate: the floor joints and the centre inlay are filled by the solid tile collider.
This is deliberate: the hopper funnel mouth is a shallow recess and is filled.
This is deliberate: the alms-box coin slot is a shallow recess in the iron plate and is filled.
The arcade opening, the space under the bench slab, the space around the hopper pipe, and the trough mouth above the water are real collider openings.
Flat slot albedos with light noise; image nodes are not in the FBX materials.

assets.name: wall-cloister-arcade
assets.desc: Kit-sized stone wall with slim piers, imposts, and an open pointed two-centred arch with a full-thickness voussoir ring. The archway is a real gap.

assets.name: tile-cloister-floor
assets.desc: Kit-sized floor tile with a mortar bed, a border, a 2-by-2 inner field and a flush iron diamond. This is deliberate: the solid cell collider fills the joints and the inlay.

assets.name: prop-cloister-bench-stone
assets.desc: Backless stone slab on two solid ends, with iron pins on the seat. The space under the slab is a real gap.

assets.name: prop-cloister-hopper
assets.desc: Wall-mounted flared lead rain hopper, with iron brackets to the back plane, a downpipe and a shoe discharging into the walk. This is deliberate: the funnel mouth is a shallow recess and is filled.

assets.name: prop-alms-box-wood
assets.desc: Timber chest on a post and plinth, with an iron strap, a hasp and a coin-slot plate on the lid. This is deliberate: the slot is a shallow recess and is filled.

assets.name: prop-cloister-trough-stone
assets.desc: Long low stone basin with a water disc below the rim and two iron staples on the outer rim. The mouth above the water is a real gap.
